name: Workflow Approval Vote Detail
description:
# Retrieve a Workflow Approval Vote:

Make GET request to this resource to retrieve a single workflow approval vote
record containing the following fields:

* `id`: Database ID for this workflow approval vote. (integer)
* `type`: Data type for this workflow approval vote. (choice)
* `url`: URL for this workflow approval vote. (string)
* `related`: Data structure with URLs of related resources. (object)
* `summary_fields`: Data structure with name/description for related resources.  The output for some objects may be limited for performance reasons. (object)
* `created`: Timestamp when this workflow approval vote was created. (datetime)
* `workflow_approval`:  (id)
* `user`:  (id)
* `vote`: Whether this user approved or denied the workflow approval. (choice)
    - `approve`: Approve
    - `deny`: Deny
* `comment`: Optional comment the user submitted along with their vote. (string)
* `workflow_approval_name`: Name of the approval node at the time of the vote, kept after the approval is deleted. (string)
* `workflow_job_id`: ID of the workflow job the approval belonged to, kept after the approval is deleted. (integer)
* `workflow_job_name`: Name of the workflow job the approval belonged to, kept after the approval is deleted. (string)
* `user_name`: Username of the voter at the time of the vote, kept after the user is deleted. (string)
